summary: Over the guest's shoulder, the host, one foot up on the windowsill, pretends he was only stretching and demonstrates.
framing: Over-the-shoulder wide shot: back of the guest's head and shoulders large in the left foreground; host full figure, small, at the window at right; stove behind the guest's head at centre-left with smoke pouring up; green wall, purple floor. Static.

cast.visible: back of head and shoulders, foreground

cast.costume: light-blue suit, lilac shirt, pink tie

props: window with sill (host's foot rests on it)
stove at centre-left, partly hidden by the guest

beats.action: stands with his back to camera, head turned slightly right so one eye and the nose tip show at the right edge of his head, looking at the host; motionless for the whole shot
thick grey smoke rises from the stove behind the guest's head, fans out across the top of the frame and over the window; churns continuously all shot

stands on his screen-left leg, screen-right leg raised with the foot on the windowsill, both hands on the raised knee, torso twisted back toward the guest, head 3/4 left, eyes wide; holds this while speaking
hunches and pulls his head back to the left, teeth clenched in a grimace, hands still on the knee
torso swings to face camera, screen-left hand comes up to his chest, other hand stays on the raised ankle at the sill, eyes wide
straightens up, raises the screen-left hand palm-out beside his chest, other arm stretched back to the sill, mouth a small o
leans forward to the left toward the guest, screen-left arm thrown down and out with an open palm, other arm trailing back to the sill; held while speaking
pulls back upright, hand lifted to chest height with fingers curled
faces camera squarely, both hands down on the raised thigh, neutral closed mouth
turns toward the window and starts to fold forward over the raised leg, hands sliding to the foot
bent right over the raised leg, both hands on the foot at the sill, head down beside the knee, face turned to camera
holds the stretch, bouncing slightly in it; head bobs between looking down at the foot and grinning out at camera
rises out of the stretch, head up, mouth wide open, hand lifting off the foot
upright and twisting left to face the guest, screen-right arm pushing back flat against the window, screen-left fist coming to his hip
settles: chest out, screen-right arm straight out to the window frame, screen-left fist on hip, foot still on the sill, broad toothy grin
leans toward the guest with the elbow cocked back and fist at the hip, head tilted, speaking; small pumps of the elbow
straightens and brings the fist up against his chest, other arm still out to the window
fist pressed to chest, sways gently while speaking, alternating grin and open mouth
turns toward the window, both hands come together toward the foot on the sill, mouth a small o
folds over the raised leg again, face turned to camera with a wide grin
head drops to look at the foot, both hands on it
deep in the stretch, chest on the thigh, head beside the knee and turned to camera, grinning; held with a slight bob to the end

notes: Camera confirmed static. The host's supporting leg and the foot on the sill never move; everything is torso, arms and head. Host is animated on twos. The guest is a held cel.
